_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: William N. Loew (1847-1922), of the New York bar, translator of Hungarian poetry: Gems from Petőfi (1881), Magyar Poetry (1899), Petőfi's The Apostle and Childe John (1912), and Madách's The Tragedy of Man (1908). His Mikszáth, Heathen Master Filcsik, is on singles-fiction-4 from Gutenberg. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 110); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_surname_note: Full name forms only; bare 'loew' is left to singles-fiction-4, which uses it for the Filcsik.
